title: Q4 2024 Earnings Preview
description: Alphabet Inc. Q4 2024 earnings preview notes

chunks.text:
Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) — Q4 2024 Earnings Preview
Prepared: January 8, 2025

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Alphabet is expected to report Q4 2024 earnings on January 28, 2025. Consensus estimates point to revenue of $86.3B (+12% YoY) and EPS of $1.92.

KEY THEMES TO WATCH
1. Cloud Revenue Growth: Google Cloud is expected to maintain 25%+ growth, driven by AI workload adoption and Gemini integration. Key question: has the enterprise pipeline converted at the rate management guided in Q3?

2. Search & AI Overview: Impact of AI Overviews on search monetization. Early data suggests ad load within AI Overviews is improving CPCs, but some analysts worry about long-term query cannibalization.

3. YouTube Performance: Shorts monetization gap is narrowing vs. long-form. Management guided for continued improvement in Q4. NFL Sunday Ticket will contribute to subscriber growth.

4. Operating Margins: Expect continued efficiency gains from headcount optimization. Consensus expects operating margin of 30.2%, up from 27.5% in Q4 2023.

5. Capital Expenditure: CapEx expected at $12-13B for Q4, primarily driven by AI infrastructure. Full-year 2024 CapEx guidance of $48-50B. Watch for 2025 CapEx guidance.

RISKS
- Regulatory headwinds from DOJ antitrust case (remedies phase)
- FX impact: strong dollar may create ~150bps revenue headwind
- Waymo cash burn trajectory

FINANCIAL ESTIMATES (Consensus)
Revenue: $86.3B
Operating Inc: $26.8B (margin: 31.1%)
Net Income: $23.4B
EPS: $1.92 (vs. $1.64 Q4 2023)

VALUATION
At current price of ~$192, GOOGL trades at 22x forward P/E, a discount to mega-cap tech peers (MSFT 33x, AAPL 30x). The discount reflects regulatory overhang but may narrow if Cloud growth accelerates.

RECOMMENDATION: Expect a solid quarter. Focus on 2025 guidance and any commentary on AI monetization roadmap.

title: Q4 2024 Earnings Recap
description: Alphabet Inc. Q4 2024 post-earnings recap notes

chunks.text:
Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) — Q4 2024 Earnings Recap
Post-Earnings Analysis: January 29, 2025

HEADLINE RESULTS
Alphabet reported a strong Q4 2024, beating consensus on both revenue and earnings. The stock rose 5.2% in after-hours trading.

FINANCIAL RESULTS vs. ESTIMATES
Revenue: $88.3B (Actual) vs $86.3B (Estimate) +2.3% beat
Operating Income: $28.9B vs $26.8B +7.8% beat
Net Income: $25.1B vs $23.4B +7.3% beat
EPS: $2.05 vs $1.92 +6.8% beat

SEGMENT BREAKDOWN
Google Search & Other: $54.0B (+14% YoY) — strongest growth in 6 quarters
YouTube Ads: $10.5B (+16% YoY) — Shorts monetization improving rapidly
Google Cloud: $11.4B (+29% YoY) — accelerating growth, now profitable
Google Other: $10.8B (+8% YoY) — Pixel, subscriptions
Other Bets: $1.6B — Waymo losses narrowing to $1.1B

KEY TAKEAWAYS
1. Cloud Inflection: Google Cloud operating margin hit 10.8%, up from 5.2% in Q4 2023. Management highlighted 100+ $100M+ ARR customers, up from 70 a year ago. Gemini integration driving higher attach rates.

2. AI Monetization Progress: AI Overviews now generating higher revenue per query than traditional search in several verticals. Management noted "early but encouraging" trends.

3. Efficiency Gains: Total headcount declined 3% YoY while revenue grew 14%. Operating margin expanded 380bps to 32.7%.

4. 2025 Guidance: CapEx guided to $52-55B (vs. $50B consensus), reflecting aggressive AI infrastructure buildout. Revenue growth expected to remain "low teens" percent.

5. Capital Return: Board authorized $70B buyback (incremental). Q4 buybacks were $15.3B.

MANAGEMENT COMMENTARY HIGHLIGHTS
CEO Sundar Pichai: "Our AI-first strategy is delivering across every product surface. Gemini is now deeply integrated into Search, Cloud, and Workspace."

CFO Ruth Porat: "We're seeing operating leverage improve as AI investments mature. Our cloud business is now a consistent profitability contributor."

UPDATED THESIS
Results confirm GOOGL's position as a key AI beneficiary. Cloud acceleration and Search resilience address the two biggest bear case concerns. Maintaining conviction.

ACTION: Maintain overweight position. Raise price target to $215 (from $200).
